what: Per-prompt verified-key counts at the terminal checkpoint (step 3072), used to place measured points on the App. A.3 decomposition axes.

derivation.q: per-key share of the pooled verified samples
derivation.x: 1 - sum_c q_c^2, the paper breadth statistic applied within a prompt
derivation.distinct8: mean over the four groups of distinct verified keys in that group
derivation.circularity_note: q and distinct@8 are estimated from the same draws, so the scatter shows internal consistency with the closed form, not an out-of-sample prediction.
